//go:build integration

package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	courseclient "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/course"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	transporthttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http"
	privatehandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/practiceroute"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// This is an owned loopback proof server, not the production main service.
// Student mastery and content generation are named fixtures. Planner routing,
// composition, receipt persistence and downstream Course HTTP are real.
func TestT08ReadinessHTTPProvider(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := os.Getenv("T08_PLANNER_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
	if dsn == "" {
		t.Skip("owned T08 provider env absent")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil || !strings.HasPrefix(cfg.ConnConfig.Database, "remediation_t07_") || !strings.HasSuffix(cfg.ConnConfig.Database, "_test") {
		t.Fatal("requires owned Planner test database")
	}
	var fixture struct {
		Schema    string           `json:"schema"`
		StudentID string           `json:"student_id"`
		Target    domain.TargetRef `json:"target"`
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("T08_RUNTIME_PROVIDER_FIXTURE_FILE"))
	if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(b, &fixture) != nil || fixture.Schema != "t08-workspace-provider-fixture.v1" {
		t.Fatal("invalid owned T08 fixture")
	}
	if os.Getenv("T08_PLANNER_TOKEN") == "" || os.Getenv("T08_COURSE_TOKEN") == "" {
		t.Fatal("test credentials required without disclosure")
	}
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(context.Background(), cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	if err := pool.Ping(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	store := postgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	mastery := &t08NamedMasteryFixture{studentID: fixture.StudentID, target: fixture.Target, phaseFile: os.Getenv("T08_MASTERY_PHASE_FILE")}
	generator := &t08NamedContentGeneratorFixture{}
	handler := transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		PracticeLearning: privatehandlers.PracticeLearningHandler{
			Routes:    newPracticeLearningResolver(store, mastery, systemClock{}),
			Materials: practiceroute.Materializer{Routes: store, Catalog: store, Generator: generator, Courses: courseclient.Client{BaseURL: os.Getenv("T08_COURSE_URL"), InternalToken: os.Getenv("T08_COURSE_TOKEN"), HTTPClient: &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}}},
		}, PracticeToken: os.Getenv("T08_PLANNER_TOKEN"),
	})
	server := httptest.NewServer(handler)
	defer server.Close()
	ready, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"base_url": server.URL, "classification": "actual Planner production factory/router/PostgreSQL; named Student and generator fixtures"})
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("T08_PLANNER_READY_FILE"), ready, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	timer := time.NewTimer(15 * time.Minute)
	defer timer.Stop()
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-timer.C:
			t.Fatal("owned proof stop signal timed out")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, err := os.Stat(os.Getenv("T08_PLANNER_STOP_FILE")); err == nil {
				summary, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"mastery_fixture_calls": mastery.calls.Load(), "content_generator_fixture_calls": generator.calls.Load(), "full_live_e2e": false})
				if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("T08_PLANNER_RESULT_FILE"), summary, 0600); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				return
			}
		}
	}
}

type t08NamedMasteryFixture struct {
	studentID string
	target    domain.TargetRef
	phaseFile string
	calls     atomic.Uint64
}

func (f *t08NamedMasteryFixture) QueryMastery(_ context.Context, studentID string, targets []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.TargetMastery, error) {
	f.calls.Add(1)
	if studentID != f.studentID || len(targets) != 1 || targets[0] != f.target {
		return nil, errors.New("owned mastery fixture identity mismatch")
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(f.phaseFile)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	m := domain.TargetMastery{Target: f.target, State: domain.MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}
	switch strings.TrimSpace(string(b)) {
	case "UNKNOWN":
	case "MASTERED":
		m.State = domain.MasteryMastered
		m.MasteryScore = .91
		m.Confidence = .92
	default:
		return nil, errors.New("invalid owned mastery phase")
	}
	return []domain.TargetMastery{m}, nil
}

type t08NamedContentGeneratorFixture struct{ calls atomic.Uint64 }

func (f *t08NamedContentGeneratorFixture) GenerateLesson(_ context.Context, input domainservice.LessonGenerationInput, _ string) (domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent, error) {
	f.calls.Add(1)
	if len(input.Lesson.Targets) != 1 {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{
		DescriptionMarkdown: "Owned deterministic prerequisite lesson fixture: events invoke handlers.",
		Examples:            []domain.PlannedExample{{Title: "Owned event example", DescriptionMarkdown: "Register a handler for an event.", Stacks: []string{"javascript"}, TargetConcepts: []string{input.Lesson.Targets[0].Key}}},
		KnowledgeChecks:     []domain.PlannedTask{{Title: "Owned check", DescriptionMarkdown: "Name the handler trigger.", ExpectedAnswers: []string{"event"}}},
	}, nil
}
